svg.title: Complex Drude conductivity with the exp(-i omega t) convention
svg.desc: Real conductivity is 1/(1+x squared), imaginary conductivity is x/(1+x squared), x=omega tau. The current lags the real field by arctan(x). At x=1 the normalized field is cos(omega t), and normalized current is cos(omega t-pi/4)/sqrt(2). Positive imaginary conductivity therefore describes a lag for exp(-i omega t).
